verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services, such as its search databases and e-filing tools, could plausibly offer programmatic or headless access, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes interactive web portals (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAregister, DEPATISnet), downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro) and paper or fax filing. Nothing documents an API, CLI, or headless/CI automation mode.
